ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) surface comprising approximately 85% of the visible mask, with low-intensity (black) margins and focal points comprising 15%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white central zone; low-intensity black perimeter along the trailing edge and tips; distinct dark irregular cluster at the left-central base; multiple small dark circular points scattered on the right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an internal pixel angle of approximately 52 degrees and a depth ratio relative to fluke height of approximately 0.18.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude peaks reaching 20-30 pixels; continuous jagged boundary transition against the sky/water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves at the distal tips; trailing edge follows a moderate concave path from the central notch to the mid-lobe before transitioning to convexity at the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two high-contrast, yellow-pigmented circular clusters (approx. 10px diameter) at the extreme right tip; several small, raised white circular pixel clusters scattered across the medial right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel low-intensity linear markings on the outer distal edges of both lobes, particularly prominent on the far left margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized barnacle colonization at the far right distal tip; extensive rake-mark scarring on the outer lateral margins of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique heart-shaped dark pigmentation cluster located in the lower-left-central region of the fluke's ventral surface.
